metadata.description: Kho dữ liệu đào tạo phương ngữ và từ lóng Việt Nam - Giai đoạn 1

phonology.note_en: The "V" sound is often softened to a "D" or "Y" sound.
In some central areas, "V" can sound like a soft "B".
"R" is pronounced as a "Z" sound in the North.
"R" is often replaced by a "G" or "Y" sound in the South.
"TR" and "CH" are often merged into a light "CH" sound.

phonology.example: "Gia đình / Da thịt / Ra đi" đều đọc là âm "Y"
phonology.note_en: These three distinct sounds are all pronounced as "Y".

phonology.region: Một số làng nghề Miền Bắc
phonology.note_en: Be careful: "L" and "N" can be interchanged in certain northern villages.
"QU" is typically pronounced like the English "W".
